title: Assignment Brief Intake
description: Structured, human or reader-agent authored intake for the assignment brief digest gate. It carries a file inventory, pre-extracted text segments with source locators, readability status, and human-declared conflicts and unknowns. It never carries binary files, and the digest builder parses no document format.

project_title.description: Project title exactly as stated in the assignment material.

path_label.description: Stable label identifying one supplied file. A label only, not a filesystem path claim.

file_type.description: Declared file type. A human declaration only, not proof of extraction support.

readability.description: Human-classified readability of the file content.

unreadable_reason.description: Required when readability is unreadable; forbidden otherwise.

segment_id.description: Stable identifier for one extracted segment.

source_file.description: path_label of the input file this segment was extracted from.

source_locator.description: Human-readable locator inside the source file, such as a page, heading, table row, or caption reference.

kind.description: Structural kind of the extracted segment.

text.description: Literal extracted text. Extraction is authored by the human or reader agent, not by this Skill.

conflict_id.description: Stable identifier for one declared conflict.

description.description: What conflicts with what, stated literally without picking a winner.

segment_ids.description: The two or more segments that disagree.

unknown_id.description: Stable identifier for one declared unknown.

expected_category.description: The requirement category the missing information belongs to.

kind.description: missing means no source supplies the information; unreadable means only an unreadable file could supply it.

description.description: What is absent and where it was expected. Absence is declared, never inferred into a value.

candidate_id.description: Stable identifier for one requirement candidate.

concise_text.description: Concise literal paraphrase of what the brief says. No design interpretation.

status.description: Coverage status of this candidate. missing and unreadable statuses are derived from declared unknowns, never from candidates.

source_segment_ids.description: Every segment that supports this candidate.

merged_from_segment_ids.description: Required for duplicate_merged; all duplicate locations, including the primary one.

conflict_ids.description: Required for conflict; the declared conflicts this candidate belongs to.

deferred_reason.description: Required for deferred_with_reason; why the item is not relevant to the current stage.

clarification_questions.description: At most three focused clarification questions for the human, authored by the reading agent.

note_id.description: Stable identifier for one human note.

text.description: A human-stated remark or assumption. Carried verbatim; never promoted to a brief requirement.

requirement_category.description: Literal requirement category from the student workflow machine contract.
